top_event: Strait of Hormuz Blockade - Iran-US War Active

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Blockade - Iran-US War
events.summary: Iran closed Strait of Hormuz in retaliation for US/Israeli strikes. 20M bbl/day disrupted. Tanker attacks ongoing. Trump claims US control; Iran denies. OPEC+ pledged 206K bpd increase. Day 169 of conflict.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC Declared
events.summary: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, second-largest ever. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (existing treatments certified for Zaire species). DRC: 4,665 confirmed cases, 2,184 deaths, 634 hospitalized. WHO declared public health emergency. Spreading across DRC and Uganda.

events.title: US-Japan Joint FX Intervention Unraveling
events.summary: First coordinated US-Japan FX intervention in 15 years (Aug 2-3). Japan spent est. $36-59B. US sold euros (not dollars) to avoid Treasury disruption. Yen already lost half its gains, back to 159. BOJ hinting at Sept rate hike. Goldman says capacity for 2 more rounds.

events.title: China Property Crisis Deepening - $148B Time Bomb
events.summary: Bloomberg: $148B property lease expiration threat. Economist: China's asset-management companies (bad debt handlers) themselves becoming distressed. Asia Times: war on deflation faltering. PBOC maintaining loose stance but no explicit cuts.

events.title: US Financial Crisis Ingredients Building
events.summary: Telegraph: US Treasury acutely dependent on short-term hedge fund funding ($8.3T money market, some at 100x leverage). 30Y Treasury at 5.2% - highest since 2007. Iran's banking system showing systemic distress. US smallest bank failure (too small to save).

events.title: Gold at $4,437 - Safe Haven Panic
events.summary: Gold surged above $4,400/oz, 2-month high. Futures touched $4,500. Up 31% YoY. Central bank buying (China) + geopolitical tensions driving demand. CoinCodex forecasts $4,587 avg August, $5,120 September.

events.title: UK Food Security Crisis + Global Food Disruption
events.summary: Telegraph: UK faces worst food security crisis in decades. 27M under hosepipe bans. Guardian: Hormuz/Red Sea/Suez disruptions hitting fertilizer and food re-exports. Ukraine grain exports down 70% in August, forecast cut 3-5M tonnes. Sudan: 400K facing starvation.

events.title: ECB Set to Deliver Rate Hike - Shortest Tightening Since 2011
events.summary: Reuters: ECB set to deliver final rate hike next month. Morningstar: ECB may raise in 2026 then cut in 2027. US sold euros (not dollars) for yen rescue, catching ECB off guard. EU Perspectives: decision undermines trust between central banks. Next ECB meeting Oct 28-29.

domain_summaries.us_fed: Fed at 3.50-3.75%, 5th consecutive hold expected. 30% probability of hike. CPI benign but debate unresolved. Fed Chair Warsh rocky debut in late July. No emergency action.
domain_summaries.latam: Argentina central bank reform vote Aug 19. Peso purchasing power destroyed. US ESF $2.5B lifeline to Argentina. Colombia new president (Aug 7) vows to confront ELN. Mexico held rate 6.50% Aug 6. No acute emergency.
domain_summaries.eu_ecb: ECB set to hike rates next month. US sold euros for yen intervention, catching ECB off-guard. Euro area crisis officially ended for Spain (EC June 2026). Next meeting Oct 28-29.
domain_summaries.uk: BOE at 3.75%, 7-2 vote to hold. Markets pricing quarter-point increase by Nov. Starmer resigned June, Burnham now PM. 10Y gilt at ~5%, 30Y at 5.7%. Wildfire emergency alerts. No acute emergency.
domain_summaries.japan: Joint US-Japan intervention unraveling. Yen at 159 after brief rally to 157. BOJ hinting Sept hike. JGB yields surging. BOJ reducing JGB holdings by 48T yen. Takaichi government pressuring BOJ.
domain_summaries.china: PBOC maintaining loose stance, 5-year reform plan. $148B property lease time bomb. AMCs distressed. Deflation war faltering. No emergency rate cuts or devaluation.
domain_summaries.em_asia: Korean won leading declines. India rupee recovered from May record low via $40B diaspora deposits. Bloomberg: currency defense makeover as EM Asia guards reserves. No acute crisis.
domain_summaries.middle_east: ACTIVE WAR. Hormuz blockade. Iran-US conflict ongoing. Gaza disarmament stalemate. Saudi cut August OSP by $11 (biggest in 2 decades). OPEC+ adding 206K bpd.
domain_summaries.africa: Ebola PHEIC in DRC/Uganda. Sudan civil war, 400K facing starvation. South Africa alleges Russia financed Benin coup attempt. Zambia election violence. No new acute sovereign emergency.
domain_summaries.financial_system: US Treasury hedge fund dependence at 100x leverage. Iran banking systemic distress. US smallest bank failed (too small to save). No credit freeze or interbank halt detected.
domain_summaries.commodities: Brent ~$93. Gold $4,437. UK food crisis. Ukraine grain exports -70%. Hormuz disrupting 20M bbl/day. EIA raises Brent forecast to $87 avg 2026. Saudi OSP cut $11.
domain_summaries.pandemic_health: WHO PHEIC: 2026 Ebola epidemic. Bundibugyo strain. 4,665 cases, 2,184 deaths. Fastest-spreading on record. Drug shortages persistent (Sanofi Pompe disease). No bioterrorism detected.
